entities.name: Tenoch
entities.description: Nacatl leonin of Alara and former tribemate of Ajani and Jazal Goldmane, who abandoned Ajani to human hunters.

entities.name: Qala
entities.description: Nacatl leonin who patrolled with Tenoch and Ajani and abandoned Ajani with Tenoch.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker, white-furred leonin whom Tenoch and Qala called jinxed.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani's brother and kha of the Nacatl tribe.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara where leonin and humans are usually not hostile.

events.summary: Tenoch and Qala are assigned to patrol with Ajani, and protest that he is jinxed; Jazal's word as kha is final.
events.quote: But Ajani's brother Jazal Goldmane was the kha of their tribe, and his word was final.

events.summary: Tenoch stumbles and Qala stops to help; the human hunters pass by to chase Ajani, and the two abandon him to his fate.
events.quote: Tenoch and Qala stayed behind, abandoning Ajani to his fate.
